description.label: Description
description.value:
The projectile slams into your mouth, breaking bone and shattering teeth.

Effects: Pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain @Condition[Unconscious], otherwise gaining @Condition[Stunned] (3). You also suffer a Broken Bone (Major) and lose 1d10 teeth – Amputation (Average). If the projectile was a Lead Bullet you must also pass a Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or also lose your tongue (see under Amputated Parts) as the almond-shaped projectile penetrates deeply, tearing through the soft tissues of your mouth. Also roll for any Pummel Quality.
